contract_source.expected_solution: protobuf v25.1 defines the well-known types under src/google/protobuf/: timestamp.proto, duration.proto, struct.proto, and any.proto (plus field_mask.proto). The comments in those files pin the JSON wire contract: Timestamp serializes to an RFC 3339 string, Duration to a decimal seconds string with an s suffix, Struct maps onto plain JSON objects with its NullValue singleton standing in for null, and Any embeds a type.googleapis.com type URL beside the payload fields.
evaluation_criteria: Cites timestamp.proto, duration.proto and struct.proto under src/google/protobuf/
Cites any.proto and its type URL contract
Describes the JSON serialization semantics the .proto comments pin down

direct_consumers.expected_solution: The gRPC v1.60.0 C++ core treats messages as opaque serialized bytes; the concrete integration point on the wire path is src/core/ext/filters/message_size/message_size_filter.cc, where ClientMessageSizeFilter and ServerMessageSizeFilter enforce serialized-size limits on every message the channel moves. googleapis (common-protos-1_3_1) consumes the well-known types directly: google/rpc/status.proto imports google/protobuf/any.proto for its repeated details field, and google/longrunning/operations.proto builds on Any for operation payloads.
evaluation_criteria: Cites message_size_filter.cc (ClientMessageSizeFilter / ServerMessageSizeFilter) as the gRPC-side wire touchpoint
Cites google/rpc/status.proto as a googleapis consumer of well-known types
Connects the googleapis protos to their google/protobuf imports

compliance_check.expected_solution: The contract chain: protobuf's WKT definitions fix the JSON forms (RFC 3339 for Timestamp, NullValue for Struct nulls, a type.googleapis.com prefix for Any type URLs); the gRPC runtime forwards serialized bytes subject to message-size filtering, so it neither repairs nor detects a semantic mismatch; googleapis protos assume those exact forms — the repeated google.protobuf.Any details field in google/rpc/status.proto only round-trips when producer and consumer agree on the type URL prefix and the JSON encodings. Drift between a v25.x serializer and an older consumer surfaces precisely at these seams as serialization errors.
evaluation_criteria: Anchors the Timestamp JSON contract in RFC 3339
Anchors the Any contract in the type.googleapis.com type URL prefix and google.protobuf.Any usage
Anchors the Struct null contract in NullValue
